question: Do the washer and underside screw head have complete nominal bearing footprints, with no fastener overlap?
stop: Eight joints, fixed planar 0.01 mm footprint prism; no mesh/load analysis.
method: Intersect bearing annulus extruded 0.01 mm into the receiving solid; volume/depth gives section area for this planar region.
criteria_origin: Numerical full-seat geometry checks, not material strength acceptance.
limits: No pressure distribution, flatness, preload or creep
No positive retention or stiffness proof from bearing area alone
